metadata.description: shuck plugins: the background CI/review monitor and failing-CI-log inspection tools

plugins.name: shuck
plugins.description: A background monitor that keeps Claude current on your PR: new CI failures with their exact failing step logs, review comments with code context, and stale GitHub Action pins — delivered as they happen, as notifications where the plugin's monitor can run and through its hooks everywhere else. Plus the on-demand shuck commands (logs, reviews, security alerts, action pinning) as a skill.
